bio_draft: Adam Rahman is an India-born techno DJ and producer based in Dubai. He was one of the early people behind Chennai's techno scene around 2000, started the Warped party series in Dubai in 2004 and runs the label KitchenSync Records. He hosted the monthly techno show WARPED on boxout.fm.

bio_sources.fact: early proponent of Chennai's techno scene around 2000; Warped party series begun in Dubai in 2004; monthly boxout.fm show WARPED

notes: from_city is soft: the boxout page says he was an original proponent of Chennai's techno scene before moving to the Middle East, not literally that he is from Chennai; RA says only born India. Param may prefer from_city null. The boxout bio spells him 'Adam Rehman'. Belong EP label not stated (Mixmag MENA says it is out on his Bandcamp; he runs KitchenSync Records). RA lists labels he has released on: Expmental Records, Unknown Territory, Diffuse Reality, Techfui, Since 16, KitchenSync Records, Postdynamic, systoliclabel, Zebra Rec., QEONE; SceneNoise profile names Bootleg Social Records (UK) and Techfui. His Bandcamp (adamrahman03.bandcamp.com) permission prompt timed out, so no per-release Bandcamp ids. Beatport 'Adam Warped' (beatport.com/artist/adam-warped/241900) is a different, US-based DJ: do not link. The RA Wild City mix URL is the SoundCloud API track URL (oEmbed confirms title 'RA / Wild City: Adam Rahman', poster Resident Advisor); permalink not resolved.

bio_draft: Aeon Waves is the project of Ahmedabad-based producer and DJ Kanishk Budhori, who also works as a sound engineer. He makes drum and bass and ambient music, has released on labels including Onset Audio, Mindtrick Records and TAABIIR, and hosted the monthly drum and bass, jungle and ambient show Equal Measure on boxout.fm.

bio_sources.fact: project of Ahmedabad-based producer/DJ Kanishk Budhori; sound engineer; labels Onset Audio, Mindtricks Records

notes: Our genres (drum and bass, jungle) match. Bandcamp also lists tracks Ethreal Tides, Supernova, Dark Matter, Terra, Memories, Starchaser, Starlight, Aura, Blurred Memories (dates not opened). The Ode To A Dying Star page describes it as a move from his 'slamming drum & bass sound' toward ambient; a second era could be split at 2019 if Param wants. Igloo also reviewed 'Mute Angel EP' (Mindtrick), page not opened. Release year for 'One Life Many Faces / Genesis' is the Wild City article date (premiered on Drum and Bass India). Bandcamp bio also names Easy Summer Group and Bearskin Records.

bio_draft: Aneesha Kotwani is a Mumbai-based radio presenter and the founder of WAVLNGTH, a music agency she started in 2016 that works on touring, artist management, radio and content. She moved to the UK in 2009, returned to India in 2013, and has presented shows on BBC Asian Network, Soho Radio, Worldwide FM and boxout.fm.

bio_sources.fact: formed WAVLNGTH in Mumbai in 2016; agency covering radio, artist strategy, management, content; BBC Asian Network and Soho Radio shows

notes: She says in Mixmag Asia 'Because I don't DJ': she is a radio presenter and agency founder, so 'selector' is the closest kind and 'dj' would be wrong. No eras: no source describes a sound of her own (Soho Radio calls her guest mix relaxed and downtempo). Mixmag says she started WAVLNGTH after returning in 2013, Mixmag Asia and Everpress say it was founded in 2016; the bio uses 2016. Worldwide FM and Soho Radio links are episode pages, not Mixcloud/SoundCloud embeds.
